# RoMetrics SDK

> Server-side Luau SDK and Roblox Studio plugin for RoMetrics, real-time analytics for Roblox games (players, CCU, sales, custom events, funnels, attribution). The event API mirrors Roblox AnalyticsService.

The single most useful file for an AI assistant is the full reference below; it contains every public function, option, rule and common mistake.

## Docs

- [Full reference for AI assistants](https://victorcarmo2003.github.io/rometrics-sdk/rometrics-sdk.ai.md): complete API, validation rules, automatic tracking, tags, attribution, pitfalls and recipes (English)
- [Getting started (pt-BR)](https://victorcarmo2003.github.io/rometrics-sdk/guia/comecando): install, Secrets Store key, first events
- [Module API reference (pt-BR)](https://victorcarmo2003.github.io/rometrics-sdk/referencia/sdk)
- [Tag attributes RM_* (pt-BR)](https://victorcarmo2003.github.io/rometrics-sdk/referencia/atributos)
- [Data sent (pt-BR)](https://victorcarmo2003.github.io/rometrics-sdk/referencia/dados-enviados)

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/victorcarmo2003/rometrics-sdk): `sdk/roblox/src` (SDK), `plugin/src` (Studio plugin), MIT license
